name: MoNuSAC 2020: Multi-Organ Nuclei Segmentation and Classification Challenge
description: MoNuSAC 2020 (ISBI 2020 Challenge) is an advanced computational pathology benchmark extending generalized nuclear segmentation to multi-class cell sub-typing. Curated from 71 patients across 37 hospitals and 4 organs (breast, kidney, lung, prostate), it comprises over 46,000 nuclei manually delineated and classified into 4 cell types: epithelial, lymphocyte, neutrophil, and macrophage. Tissue sections in .svs and .tif format at 40x magnification contain ~31,000 training nuclei annotations and ~15,000 testing nuclei annotations, alongside binary masks identifying ambiguous histological areas with faint or fuzzy cell boundaries.
